notes.title: Let's Get Back
notes.content:
Lifegaurd catches another breath and accelerates. Forestlight Games is joined by SouthTown Games, the combined forces of the two studios will allow to give even more quality to our game. SouthTown Games is a new studio founded by game market veteran Lukasz Kubiak behind such games as Kholat and Seven: The Days Long Gone. Lifeguard Simulator is the first step in the collaboration. Forestlight produces several exciting games in the simulator segment like American Camper and Rollercoaster Mechanic so it is eager to benefit from both Lukasz's experience and the enthusiasm of the new team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37810852/b7c9416b3e1407eba0c9648068394774dc287ccc.jpg[/img]

Work on the development of Lifeguard Simulator has started in full swing, and players will be able to see the first results in early October at the PGA trade show in Poznan, Poland.

Both studios are committed to delivering the highest quality games that bring joy to players like you. So, stay tuned for more exciting updates and get ready for an unforgettable gameplay experience! Add the game to your Wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1320170/Lifeguard_Simulator/

notes.title: Shark Attack
notes.content:
What should lifeguards do during a shark attack?

In the case of a shark attack, wherein the shark repeatedly bites or pursues a human, the water in the immediate area should be cleared of all swimmers and kept clear until it can be determined that the immediate threat is over.

During the game, you will often have a close encounter with this giant.

In the last period of our work, we focused precisely on interactions with sharks.

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Remember about suntan oil
notes.content:
Hello, Lifeguard Simulator community!

In May we introduced many new features and improvements to our game. First of all, we can now ride a quad bike on the beach. You can get on it and go crazy all over the beach - just be careful not to run into resting sunbathers! To make navigation easier, we've also added a compass in the upper right corner, and the current mission objective is indicated by the green dot on the edge of the compass.  The tasks of the current mission are also briefly described by the tracklog below the compass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37810852/f436aaee595381e42eeb186161f0ae4ec7435648.jpg[/img]

If you look closely at the above graphics, you will also easily see ... the drone on the quad's trunk! But this is not some dummy model or ordinary graphics, because this drone is at your disposal, and you can fly it wherever you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37810852/8c77e257e8fc22696c99b3f62edf316c18464549.jpg[/img]

To make it easier for you to control the drone, it has been equipped with an altimeter (you can decrease and increase the flight altitude) and a tilt gauge. This gadget is just perfect for patrolling the seashore in search of sunbathers in need of help.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37810852/506ac4b1ad00cac0609772908dbd38bcc885e36a.jpg[/img]

If you get bored of sky-high flights, we invite you to a stylish, wooden motorboat, equipped with a powerful engine. With its help, you can easily pick out and transport sunbathers who need medical attention to the shore... and in your free time you can indulge in carefree fun by running over inflatable toys left on the water by forgetful swimmers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37810852/6ed7eca5f13be8f12a0c67d28c8c2acfb43eeebf.jpg[/img]

Remember, however, that it is not always safe on our beach. Using advanced binoculars you can observe gangsters from a safe distance who carry suspicious loads in fast motorboats – what is hidden in these mysterious boxes? 

As you can see, we've been through a busy month rolling out and testing all these great additions. Soon we will publish more information on further improvements to our game – stay tuned and see you on the beach!
